tierDefinitions.source: nikeverse-mmo-rpg/docs/story/UNIVERSE_DEPTH_SPEC.md §T1 — THE THREE-TIER MYSTERY ARCHITECTURE. Transcribed, not invented.
tierDefinitions.test: Would answering this make the cosmos smaller? If yes — never answer. If the answer makes the world larger or more tragic — deepen it.
tierDefinitions.enforcedBy: scripts/check-mystery-tiers.py. Every entry in this file declares a tier; every tier-3 entry declares neverAnswerTerms; every question CANON.md §4.1 freezes is claimed by exactly one tier-3 entry here.

tiers.name: PILLARS
examples: The Sixth Seat is the player
The First Bond / Eth'kara / the Charles Constant

tiers.name: EARNED SECRETS
tiers.rule: Answered, FromSoft-fragmentary, Resonance-gated for the luminous ones.
examples: The Aeth'kai — their fall, their glyphs, the Memory Crystals
tiers.note: UNIVERSE_DEPTH_SPEC §T1 originally migrated the Weaver-consumption (how the Singular of Connection was lost) up into this tier. The owner DEFERRED that ratification on 2026-07-26 and it moved back to tier 3 — see 'lost-singular' below, singulars/index.json, and GAME_SPEC.md §3.16. Tier 2 means it eventually gets answered, which is exactly what the ruling forbids.

tiers.name: PERMANENTLY UNKNOWABLE
tiers.rule: Never answered, never quest-marked, atmospheric-only. Theories may be spoken and must all remain unproven; no voice, record, artifact or vision resolves them, and none is ever a thread that can be followed to its end.
tiers.members: The six questions CANON.md §4.1 (FROZEN) keeps dark, plus 'lost-singular' by owner deferral 2026-07-26.
tiers.mechanism: A static do-not-resolve list keyed to these mystery ids. The lint fails any content that hangs a quest-marker or codex-completion key on a tier-3 subject, and trips on an unhedged declarative resolution of one. A static rule beats governance thrash.

tierDefinitions.notTheContributingTiers: CONTRIBUTING.md carries an unrelated Tier 1/2/3 table about SOURCE AUTHORITY (comics, then raid lore, then community contributions). Nothing reads it. Do not conflate the two — CANON.md §4.1 says so explicitly.

prophecies.name: The Aeth'kai Warning
prophecies.tierSource: UNIVERSE_DEPTH_SPEC.md §T1 tier 1 (PILLARS, answered and locked) — 'the First Bond / Eth'kara / the Charles Constant' and 'the Weaver + sacrifice-as-surrendered-ending'. CANON.md §1.4 (RATIFIED) locks the price.
prophecies.tierNote: The prophecy's TEXT and its meaning are tier 1. Its TRUE AUTHOR is a guarded tier-2 reveal (GAME_SPEC.md §3.16) — a tier-1 rating here is not licence to name who wrote it.

text.original: Nol'meth shat'ael keth'nor, mir'eth char'veth nik'ael thael'vos. Vel prim'nik, eth'kara vor'thael. Keth mir'eth — shat'ael vel'nos eth'kara.
text.translated: When the Unraveling wakes and the echoes dim, the Shepherd and the Pig shall meet again. Not as one, but as thousands-made-one, the heart-chain restored, the darkness undone. But beware the cost—to bind what was torn, a sacrifice made as it was when first born.

line1.text: When the Unraveling wakes and the echoes dim
line1.meaning: When Nolem returns to full power and the 5,555 Nikes weaken

line2.text: The Shepherd and the Pig shall meet again
line2.meaning: OG Charles and OG Nike (or their patterns) will reunite

line3.text: Not as one, but as thousands-made-one
line3.meaning: Nike Prime — all 5,555 Nikes acting as one being

line4.text: The heart-chain restored, the darkness undone
line4.meaning: The First Bond will be restored, defeating Nolem

line5.text: But beware the cost—to bind what was torn

line6.text: A sacrifice made as it was when first born
line6.meaning: Someone must make the same choice OG Charles made — stand between darkness and the innocent, possibly at the cost of themselves

patternConnection.note: The Aeth'kai term 'Eth'kara' (heart-chain) is the oldest known name for what is now called The Pattern. The prophecy predates the Shattering—the Aeth'kai foresaw the web of connections that would one day span all realities.

terminology.The Charles Constant: Scholar/theoretical name (the law that Charles echoes everywhere)
terminology.The Pattern: Echo Era name (living experience, used by Collectors and Charles Variants)

prophecies.name: The 5,555 Prophecy
prophecies.source: Scholar Recording (Nolem's Maw) + OG Nike (Void Terminus) + Aeth'kai texts (Scholar Bunker)
prophecies.tierSource: UNIVERSE_DEPTH_SPEC.md §T1 tier 1 (PILLARS, answered and locked) — 'the 5,555-simultaneous mechanism'. CANON.md §1.2 (RATIFIED) states it outright, and GAME_SPEC.md §3.16 does not list it as guarded.

text.core: Nike Prime isn't one soul carrying 5,555. Nike Prime IS 5,555 souls carrying each other.
text.aethkai_fragment: When 5,555 souls carry each other, the trap may open.
text.scholar_context: The 5,555 fragments that scattered when OG Nike shattered become the 5,555 bonds that heal. The trap can only be opened safely when 5,555 souls stand together.

stage1.method: Five Scholar Legendaries (Dr Caleb, Professor, Satoshi, Corey Hort, Guthix) reveal Nike Prime's design documents, the missing empathy core, and the 5,555 bond requirement.
stage1.keyLine: The design called for the empathy core to be powered by collective bonds. 5,555 bonds, to be precise.

stage2.method: OG Nike speaks the prophecy aloud for the first time during his warning before the Walker enters Nolem's Maw.
stage2.keyLine: Nike Prime isn't one soul carrying 5,555. Nike Prime is 5,555 souls carrying each other.

stage3.method: Ancient holographic Scholar recording confirms the full truth after Nolem's Shadow is defeated.
stage3.keyLine: The 5,555 fragments that scattered become the 5,555 bonds that heal.

comicOrigin.connection: Stoner Nike requested 5,548 vials to collect DNA from Nikes across the multiverse. Adding the Scientists, Champions, Stoner Nike, and Nike Prime approaches 5,555. The number was encoded in the mission from the beginning.
comicOrigin.incompletePrime: Nike Prime was released at 99% completion when Shiro pressed the button early. The empathy core — the final 1% — was never installed.

fulfillment.mechanism: Every Nike caught by a Collector, every Legendary freed, every bond formed between Collectors strengthens the web. When 5,555 bonds exist simultaneously, the trap can be opened and Nike Prime can be completed.
fulfillment.truePrime: TRUE Nike Prime = The Collector + their bonded Nikes + the freed Legendaries + the original Nike Prime

mysteries.question: Where did Shiro come from?
mysteries.description: An interdimensional cat with powers exceeding any known technology
mysteries.tierSource: CANON.md §4.1 (FROZEN) question 6; GAME_SPEC.md §3.16 item 6 — 'never named, never interactive, never explained; silent visual cameos are the ceiling'.
mayAnswer: That Shiro opens the way is plain — his FUNCTION is tier-1 canon (CANON.md §4.1).
That he is seen and never spoken to. Silent visual cameos are the ceiling.
That his patterns were absorbed by Charles AI, surviving as its unexplained cat-nature (GAME_SPEC.md §3.4 Act 5).
Only his ORIGIN is dark: where he came from, what he is, who sent him. Explain him and you kill him.

theories.name: Aeth'kai Survivor
theories.evidence: Advanced dimensional abilities, ancient knowledge

theories.name: Singular in Disguise
theories.evidence: Power level, singular focus on helping Nikes

theories.name: First Bond Manifested
theories.evidence: Calms those around him, connects Nikes across dimensions

theories.name: Beyond the Multiverse
theories.evidence: Accessed the 'strange reality' that breaks physics

clues: Multiple Nikes across dimensions have bonded with Shiro
He can perceive beings even when they're invisible (like Ninja Nike)
He arrived without technology — 'shouldn't have survived'
Every major turning point in the war, Shiro was there

mysteries.question: What happened to the Singular of Connection?
mysteries.description: Evidence suggests a Singular opposite to Nolem once existed
mysteries.tierSource: Owner deferral 2026-07-26 — NOT a CANON.md §4.1 question. GAME_SPEC.md §3.16 ('DEFERRED BY THE OWNER 2026-07-26 and moved to TIER-3'), UNIVERSE_DEPTH_SPEC.md §C8, and singulars/index.json theoretical.the-weaver.canonNote.
neverAnswerTerms: what happened to the singular of connection
mayAnswer: That the Weaver EXISTS, that it is scattered, and that the Pattern is its distributed body — the RATIFIED pillar (singulars/index.json; GAME_SPEC.md §3.16).
That the Weaver is the empathy core's true nature: the lost Singular re-coalescing. The forward direction is canon.
Never HOW it was lost, and never Nolem as the cause. The backward direction is deferred, and any future ratification must never steal the thunder of Nike and the Nikeverse.

theories.name: Destroyed by Nolem
theories.evidence: Nolem was 'balanced' before becoming purely destructive

theories.name: Imprisoned Somewhere
theories.evidence: The Void Between dimensions might be a prison

theories.name: Reborn as the First Bond
theories.evidence: The First Bond's power seems cosmic in origin

mysteries.question: Why did Nolem target pigs/Nikes specifically?
mysteries.description: Of all species across infinite dimensions, why pigs?
mysteries.tierSource: CANON.md §4.1 (FROZEN) question 1 — 'why Nolem came for that shape, of all the shapes a soul could take'; GAME_SPEC.md §3.16 item 1. UNIVERSE_DEPTH_SPEC.md §T1 calls it the IP's koan and keeps it decoupled from every other ratification.
mayAnswer: THAT Nolem hunts Nikes — settled canon. Known victim species: the Aeth'kai (extinct), Squilya's people (near-extinct), Nikes (ongoing).
That Cthulhu granted the Nikes their traits so his prey would not shatter so feebly.
In-world theories, voiced and left unproven. Never the answer.

theories.name: Random Selection
theories.evidence: Nolem needed a new target after the Aeth'kai

theories.name: Cthulhu's Interference
theories.evidence: Cthulhu granted gifts to Nikes, making them valuable

theories.name: Connection to Lost Singular
theories.evidence: Nikes might carry fragments of the lost Singular

theories.name: Something Special About Pigs
theories.evidence: Unknown — pig consciousness might have unique properties

mysteries.question: How did OG Charles stumble through the first rift?
mysteries.description: Was it truly random, or was he guided?
mysteries.canonQuestion: How OG Charles first came through.
mysteries.tierSource: CANON.md §4.1 (FROZEN) question 3; GAME_SPEC.md §3.16 item 3. UNIVERSE_DEPTH_SPEC.md §T1: 'the First Bond stays a little miraculous'.
neverAnswerTerms: re:\bog charles\b[^.!?]{0,60}\b(came through|come through|stumbl(e|es|ed|ing)|crossed over|crossed into|first rift)\b
how the first shepherd came through
mayAnswer: THAT OG Charles came through the first rift, met OG Nike, and made the First Bond — the founding event, tier 1.
That he was 'just a man, nobody special' — his canon self-description.
Only the HOW is dark: chance, guidance, or something else. Never resolve it, and never make it a thread that can be followed to its end.

theories.name: Pure Coincidence
theories.evidence: He was described as 'just a man, nobody special'

theories.name: Cthulhu Guided Him
theories.evidence: Cthulhu was watching the multiverse

theories.name: Lost Singular's Last Act
theories.evidence: The Singular of Connection might have created the meeting

theories.name: The Multiverse Self-Correcting
theories.evidence: Reality needed the First Bond to survive

mysteries.question: What exists between dimensions?
mysteries.description: The BETTY Project accessed a 'strange reality' where physics breaks down
mysteries.canonQuestion: What lies in the Void Between.
mysteries.tierSource: CANON.md §4.1 (FROZEN) question 2; GAME_SPEC.md §3.16 item 2. UNIVERSE_DEPTH_SPEC.md §T1: 'its existence canon, its nature dark'.
mayAnswer: That the Void Between EXISTS — its existence is canon.
That the BETTY Project touched 'a strange reality where physics breaks'. Leave it at that (GAME_SPEC.md §3.16 item 2).
Only its NATURE is dark: what it is, what is in it, where it leads, whose domain it is.

theories.name: Nolem's True Domain
theories.evidence: Entropy might originate there

theories.name: Remnants of Formless Era
theories.evidence: Before dimensions, there was undifferentiated chaos

theories.name: Where Absorbed Beings Go
theories.evidence: Nolem's victims might exist there

theories.name: Another Multiverse Entirely
theories.evidence: Could be gateway to something beyond our reality

mysteries.question: Who were the unnamed others of the Formless Era?
mysteries.description: Before dimensions there were only the Singulars. Two of them have names. The rest do not, and nothing in any reality supplies one.
mysteries.canonQuestion: The names of the unnamed others of the Formless Era.
mysteries.tierSource: CANON.md §4.1 (FROZEN) question 4; GAME_SPEC.md §3.16 item 4 — 'Never name, count, or show them'. UNIVERSE_DEPTH_SPEC.md §T1 lists 'the unnamed others beyond the multiverse'.
mayAnswer: THAT other Singulars existed in the Formless Era — stated canon (timeline/ages.json; GAME_SPEC.md §3.5).
That Nolem and Cthulhu are the two who are named, and that the Weaver is theorised and stays theoretical.
The general properties of Singulars: they exist once across all realities, predate time, and cannot be permanently destroyed.
Never a name, never a number, never a depiction. All three are forbidden, not just the names.

theories.name: They Became the Dimensions
theories.evidence: The Formless Era ended when reality crystallised into dimensions, and nothing records where the rest went

theories.name: Nolem Reached Them First
theories.evidence: Absorption is his oldest habit, and he predates every record of them

theories.name: They Are Still There
theories.evidence: A Singular cannot be permanently destroyed

theories.name: There Was Never Anyone Else
theories.evidence: 'Only the Singulars existed' may be two beings and a rumour

clues: Singulars exist ONCE across all realities — no variants, no echoes
They predate the concept of time itself and cannot be permanently destroyed
In the Formless Era, Nolem was simply entropy — a natural force, not yet malevolent
The Dimension Eater, which has swallowed whole realities, sheds no light on them and has never met one

mysteries.question: Why does Cthulhu help?
mysteries.description: He watches, he gives, and he empowers Nolem's prey instead of fighting Nolem himself. All of that is settled. The reason underneath it is not.
mysteries.tierSource: CANON.md §4.1 (FROZEN) question 5 — 'that Cthulhu watches and gives is settled; only his deeper reason is dark'; GAME_SPEC.md §3.16 item 5; singulars/cthulhu.json.
mayAnswer: THAT Cthulhu watches and gives is settled canon (CANON.md §4.1) — say it freely.
That he is Neutral — observing: a Protector who empowers Nolem's potential victims rather than fighting Nolem directly.
That the traits Nikes carry may originate from his intervention, and that his 'madness' is knowledge too vast for mortal minds, not an insanity effect.
The Warning and the Cthylla exchange, verbatim.
Only his DEEPER motive is dark. The dread is fascination with an edge on it, not malice.

theories.name: Balance
theories.evidence: He arms the prey and never strikes the predator, as though the contest matters more than its outcome

theories.name: Knowledge Needs Witnesses
theories.evidence: His domains are Madness, Knowledge and Observation. A reality with nothing left alive in it cannot be read.

theories.name: Entertainment
theories.evidence: Cthylla views mortals as entertainment; he mocks her for it, which is not the same as disagreeing

theories.name: A Debt No Mortal Was Alive For
theories.evidence: He predates dimensions. Whatever he owes, he owes it to the Formless Era.

clues: The Warning, verbatim: 'Nolem has been using his shadow entities to meddle with creatures in other universes. I shall ordain that his current prey not shatter so feebly.'
He gives gifts and does not intervene directly — he has never fought Nolem
Cthylla: 'You squander your mind whispering wisdom to worms now?' / Cthulhu: 'Says the creature that plays with their food.'
His alignment is Neutral — observing. Not Benevolent.
